title: TABLETS
instructions: In making nourishing, retainable food for invalids and children, and for ice-cream and delicious desserts. If you have never tried Junket Tablets, order some now.
Ten Tablets, 10 cents, or a box of 100 for 75 cents, postpaid.
DEAR SIRS:---Please send us 50 cents' ($0.50) worth of your Junket Tablets.

GENTLEMEN:---Enclosed find twenty cents, for which kindly send me two packages of your Junket Tablets.

I had four tablets left over from four years ago, and have been using two each day lately, and I find they are as active and fine as food results as they were when first bought. I used them for an invalid, and they were much relished and gave good results.
